name: Longstride Shift (Shifting)
body:
Benefit: You gain a +5ft bonus to your base land speed for each Shifting feat you possess. This shift lasts for 1 hour.

Special: At 3 Shifting feats, you may ignore difficult terrain when moving or charging.

At 5 Shifting feats, you may move up to your movement speed once per encounter as a swift action.
